subject: Security of Shiny-server, can it be hacked?

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Security of Shiny-server, can it be hacked?
parts:
Hi Shiny-server users,
  I have written some shiny-server application, and will open it to public. However, we are not sure Shiny-server is secure enough to protect our sensitive data. 
  Our Shiny-server is located on a Ubuntu machine, together with some data store as .RData. User should can only get some kind of summarized statistic result, but not detail information.

  Anybody has some comment about this? I mean whether Shiny-server be easily hacked?

Regards!

Huidong Tian
